subject: Day 0 playbook, speaker rundown & asset bundling for Veridian workshop
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Holden <claire.holden@veridian.com>, Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@veridian.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Day 0 playbook, speaker rundown & asset bundling for Veridian workshop

Team / Claire —

Thanks again for confirming the Nov 30–Dec 1 onsite. I pulled together a first pass Day 0 playbook and an initial asset bundle (attached). High level asks in this email:

- Objective: Align execs on value + deployment commitment window. We’ll run a 90‑minute Day 0 executive primer, followed by smaller breakouts.
- Speakers: I’ve tentatively assigned 10‑minute segments below. Speakers — please confirm or propose swaps by EOD Thursday (11/26).
- Assets: We need a 1‑page exec summary for Veridian leadership (Claire requested), a 3–4 slide run-of-show slide for AV, and final slide decks from each speaker by COB Monday (11/29).

Draft Day 0 flow (90 minutes):
- 0:00–0:05 — Welcome & objectives (Marissa)
- 0:05–0:20 — Customer context + goals (Claire — external)
- 0:20–0:30 — Redwood platform overview & SLOs (Jonas)
- 0:30–0:40 — Deployment path & security controls (Rishi)
- 0:40–0:60 — Exec Q&A + alignment items (Marissa + Neha)
- 0:60–0:90 — Next steps / Mutual Action Plan (Neha)

Attachments included: Day0_playbook_v1.pdf (playbook & run-of-show), preflight_checklist.xlsx (ops checklist), exec_onepager_v1.docx (starter one-pager). I’ve also linked a Drive folder below for versioned assets.

Claire / Alyssa — can you confirm the exec arrival window (we have them slated to arrive 11/30 10:30–11:30am) and whether the CIO will join remotely vs in person? That will change how we run the Q&A.

Notes to internal folks: keep talk tracks tight (no deep technical demos during Day 0). Bring one slide that lists ask/decision for the customer.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Customer Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0124

Attachments:
- Day0_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 12 pages)
- preflight_checklist.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)
- exec_onepager_v1.docx (Word, draft)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Holden <claire.holden@veridian.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Day 0 playbook, speaker rundown & asset bundling for Veridian workshop

Thanks — this looks good. I can own welcome + Q&A closure. A couple of quick asks:

- Can we add speaker bios (1 short line) to the Drive folder so Claire can share with her execs?
- Please include an AV slide that shows mics + laptop inputs — campus AV team asked for that.

Jonas — I’ll hand the floor to you at 0:20. If you want to shift to a 12‑minute deep value section, I can shorten the welcome.

On travel: I’ll arrive evening of 11/29 (red-eye) and will be onsite all day 11/30. Jonas — are you driving or flying? If you’re flying we should coordinate hotel rooms (same property) to simplify logistics.

On quoting Neha’s note: I updated the playbook with a slimmed run-of-show and a page for speaker asks (see attached updated playbook v1.1 in Drive).

—Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Neha / Marissa —

This is great, thanks. Confirming: exec arrival window is 11/30 10:45am–11:15am. CIO will join in person but needs the exec one‑pager ahead of time so he can prep (please send by EOD 11/27).

Two small requests from my side:
- Please include a one‑slide summary of security posture (high level) that Rishi can present — CIO will want to see where data residency and audit logs live.
- Can you share speaker bios and headshots in the Drive folder? CFO may circulate a short deck to his EA.

We’ll confirm an AV tech on Friday and share the room layout. If you can provide the 3–4 run-of-show slides in native PPTX, that would be ideal for their AV team.

Claire
VP, Strategy & Partnerships | Veridian Health

Perfect — thanks Claire. Quick status & next steps: 

- Exec one‑pager: I’ll push an updated exec_onepager_v1.1.docx to Drive by EOD 11/27 (items: key asks, timeline options, governance owners).
- Security slide: Rishi — can you draft a 1‑slide high‑level security posture (data residency + audit logs) and drop into the Drive Security > Slides folder by COB 11/27?
- Speaker bios/headshots: Marissa will collect short bios; please drop headshots (png/jpg) in Drive /assets/headshots/ by 11/28.
- Final slide decks from each speaker due COB 11/29 — we’ll assemble a single master deck for AV. Please name files like: "SpeakerLastName_Veridian_Day0.pptx".
- AV: I’ll upload a native PPTX run-of-show and a PDF handout for the room.

Drive links & checklist: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-playbook-veridian
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-8743

If we hit these milestones we should be green for Day 0. I’ll run a 30‑minute dry run on 11/29 09:00am PT — invite to follow.

Thanks all —
Neha
